sql: SELECT T2.score, CAST(T1.num_students * T1.pct_international_students AS REAL) / 100 FROM university_year AS T1 INNER JOIN university_ranking_year AS T2 ON T1.university_id = T2.university_id WHERE T2.year = 2015 AND T1.university_id = 100

SELECT DISTINCT T1.country_name FROM country AS T1 INNER JOIN university AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.country_id INNER JOIN university_year AS T3 ON T2.id = T3.university_id WHERE T3.year = 2013 AND T3.num_students * 100 > (SELECT AVG(num_students) FROM university_year) * 98

SELECT SUM(T1.num_students) - SUM(CAST(T1.num_students * T1.pct_international_students AS REAL) / 100) FROM university_year AS T1 INNER JOIN university AS T2 ON T1.university_id = T2.id WHERE T2.university_name = 'Harvard University' AND T1.year BETWEEN 2011 AND 2012

SELECT CAST(T1.num_students * T1.pct_international_students AS REAL) / 100 FROM university_year AS T1 INNER JOIN university AS T2 ON T1.university_id = T2.id WHERE T2.university_name = 'Harvard University' AND T1.year = 2012
